content.title: Airline stocks slip on continued delays, Beyond Meat stock falls
content.description:
Josh Lipton recaps three of the top stories on Wall Street as part of Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.

Nvidia (NVDA) and CoreWeave (CRWV) are some of the tech stocks in the red during Tuesday's session.

Airline stocks, like Delta Air Lines (DAL), United (UAL), and American (AAL), are under pressure as flight delays are expected to continue beyond the government shutdown.

Beyond Meat (BYND) stock tumbles after issuing a weak outlook.

Stay up to date on the latest market action, minute-by-minute, with Yahoo Finance's Market Minute.

content.title: Trump Warns Air Traffic Controllers to Work or Get ‘Docked’
content.summary: Air traffic controllers have worked without pay since the shutdown began on Oct. 1.  “For those Air Traffic Controllers who were GREAT PATRIOTS, and didn’t take ANY TIME OFF for the ‘Democrat Shutdown Hoax,’ I will be recommending a BONUS of $10,000 per person for distinguished service to our Country,” he said.  Asked during an interview on Fox News later Monday where he would obtain funding for the bonuses, Trump said: “I don’t know.”

content.title: Delta Air Lines (DAL): Assessing Valuation as Flight Schedules Adjusted Due to Air Traffic Control Staffing Shortages
content.summary: Delta Air Lines (DAL) is adjusting its flight schedule at 40 major U.S. airports because of air traffic control staffing shortages related to the ongoing government shutdown. The company is implementing capacity reductions to address these operational hurdles. See our latest analysis for Delta Air Lines. content.title: How long until US shutdown flight chaos returns back to normal?
content.description:
The US Senate voted 60-to-40 on a procedural measure to advance a bill that could end the government shutdown to the House.

Bloomberg Intelligence senior aerospace defense and airlines industry analyst George Ferguson comes on Market Catalysts to speak more about the pressure that major airline operators have felt under what has now been the longest-ever US government shutdown.
